acceptance: The intended validation status for a seeded DataFrame TPC-H run with skipped parameter-sensitive counts is decided and recorded
SQL and DataFrame paths either agree or the difference is documented where maintainers stage bundles
description: Found 2026-11-11. With `--seed 42` at SF 0.01, DuckDB (SQL) and Polars DataFrame both skip the 8 parameter-sensitive row counts (Q2, Q9, Q11, Q13, Q16, Q18, Q20, Q21). The SQL bundle records summary.validation `passed`; the DataFrame bundle records `uncertain` (benchbox/core/dataframe/query_validation.py: any skipped row gives UNCERTAIN), so corpus staging skips it as validation_not_clean. At SF 1 a seeded DataFrame run has no reference at all, and `--official` requires a seed, so no DataFrame TPC-H bundle can be both official and stageable. The live corpus shows the effect: every Polars TPC-H result is unranked. Without a seed the Polars SF 0.1 run validates 22 of 22 and stages. Decide whether the stricter DataFrame rule is intended; if so document that DataFrame corpus runs must use default parameters, and if not align the two paths.
